{{Quote|Three fluffy hotcakes prepared just the way they make 'em on the red-water moon in the Panna system. Served fresh off the robo-griddle with bantha butter and carbosyrup.|Dex's Diner menu, on its Panna cakes|<ref name="Menu" />}}
A robo-griddle was a device that could be used to cook [[Panna cake]]s and [[Iktotch toast]].<ref name="Menu" /> At some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]],<ref name="DexDates">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}} is set at some point no earlier than [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]] per the {{DiningAtDexDate}}.</ref> the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|coruscant]], sold both Panna [[Cake/Legends|cakes]] and Iktotch [[Toast/Legends|toast]] prepared on a robo-griddle.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Robo-griddles were created<ref name="Story Behind">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref> for "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
